title: ReplicatedStorage
summary: The shared container: everything parented here replicates to all clients and is also visible to the server. Standard home for remotes, shared modules, and prefabs both sides need.

details.heading: Replication
details.body: Children replicate to every client automatically. Anything placed here should be considered public: clients can read all of it (exploiters included).

details.heading: What belongs here
details.body: RemoteEvents/RemoteFunctions, shared ModuleScripts, asset prefabs both sides instantiate, shared config. Server-only logic belongs in ServerStorage/ServerScriptService instead.

details.heading: Timing
details.body: Clients may start running LocalScripts before every ReplicatedStorage item arrives — always WaitForChild on the client.

explanation.whatItIs: The 'visible to everyone' bookshelf. Server and clients can both reach in; anything you shelve here gets copied to every player's machine.
explanation.whyItExists: Client and server need common materials — remotes to talk through, modules to share, models to clone. This container is the hand-off point.
whenToUse: Prefabs both sides need (weapons, pickups, effects)
whenNotToUse: Server secrets, authoritative tables, or anti-cheat data — use ServerStorage
Client-only assets — put those in client containers (StarterPlayerScripts, etc.)
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
ReplicatedStorage
   │  replicates
   ▼
All clients can read it
(Server reads it too)

Rule of thumb: if the client must SEE it, it goes here.
If only the SERVER should see it → ServerStorage.
```
tips: Organize with folders: Remotes/, Modules/, Assets/
Scripts parented here DO run on the server — but LocalScripts here also run on clients once replicated
commonMistakes: Storing admin commands or prices you'll trust blindly — clients can read everything here
Forgetting WaitForChild on the client and getting nil on the first run
Putting a LocalScript here expecting it to run server-side

examples.title: Standard remote setup
examples.code:
-- Server (once at startup):
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local remotes = Instance.new("Folder")
remotes.Name = "Remotes"
local buyEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
buyEvent.Name = "Buy"
buyEvent.Parent = remotes
remotes.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

-- Client:
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local buyEvent = remotes:WaitForChild("Buy")
buyEvent:FireServer("Sword")
